citations.desc: Attending veterinarian and adequate veterinary care.
citations.narrative:
The facility did not have a written program of veterinary care (PVC) available at the time of the inspection. The PVC helps
provide the facility with guidance regarding veterinary care and ensures the provision of adequate animal care and use.
Each research facility, in consultation with their AV, must have a written program of veterinary care for the animals at the
facility that shall include regularly scheduled visits to the facility. The facility should ensure that the written program of
veterinary care is available for review during all USDA inspections.
Correct by August 21, 2026.

The registrant has not yet developed and documented a contingency plan for their animals. The lack of a contingency
plan could increase the risk of not being able to safeguard animals during emergencies or disasters.
Research facilities must develop, document, and follow an appropriate plan to provide for the humane handling,
treatment, transportation, housing, and care of their animals in the event of an emergency or disaster. The plan must
address the requirements listed in (l)(1)(i)-(l)(1)(iv) of this section.
Correct by August 21, 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
